verdict.rationale: Martin is a cloud-based personal assistant reached through chat channels (phone, SMS, WhatsApp, email, Slack) and a web/desktop app, and it runs scheduled background tasks. The evidence shows no CLI, documented API, or CI/headless mode, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Background briefings, email triage and custom shortcuts are adjacent automation features, not a way to run the product headlessly from scripts or CI.
